builds.name: Lay Waste: isolated double damage
builds.summary: Investigate high one isolated Lay Waste impact output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one isolated Lay Waste impact output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Q deals 40/59/78/97/116 + 0.35 AP magic and doubles when it hits exactly one enemy. Rank-5 isolated nominal damage is 232 + 0.7 AP. This experiment scores one impact, not an assumed cooldown-perfect chain.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. No free permanent stacks. Record actual AD/AP and resists. Loaded owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. Stop observed scoring on death and report raw overkill separately. Seraph legally transformed. Exactly one enemy of any kind inside the blast; no minions, pets or neighboring champion. No W MR reduction or allied debuffs. One legal cast with observed mana and cast location.

kitEvidence.formula: Karthus creates a blast of magic, dealing [40 / 59 / 78 / 97 / 116 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage. If the blast hits only one enemy, it instead deals [(40 / 59 / 78 / 97 / 116 + (0.35) × AP) × (2)] magic damage.
